ui:help.en: The upstream API key, sent as Authorization: Bearer and stored encrypted.
ui:help.zh: 上游 API Key，以 Authorization: Bearer 发送，加密保存。

ui:help.en: Required service root, without a trailing /v1 or /api/v3. Relative endpoints below resolve against this address.
ui:help.zh: 必填服务根地址，不带尾部 /v1 或 /api/v3。下面的相对端点按此地址解析。

ui:title.zh: 兼容配置：文本 API 前缀

ui:help.en: Preserves existing text/image relay integrations; defaults to /v1.
ui:help.zh: 保留已有文本与图片中转接入，默认 /v1。

ui:title.zh: 兼容配置：视频 API 前缀

ui:placeholder.en: Leave empty to follow the API path prefix
ui:placeholder.zh: 留空则跟随「API 路径前缀」

ui:help.en: Used only when the new video endpoint is empty. Appends /contents/generations/tasks. Empty follows the text API prefix.
ui:help.zh: 仅在新视频端点留空时使用，自动追加 /contents/generations/tasks。留空跟随文本 API 前缀。

ui:placeholder.en: Leave empty to keep the asset library off

ui:help.en: Optional asset Access Key. Fill together with Secret Key and an asset endpoint.
ui:help.zh: 素材库 Access Key；与 Secret Key、素材库端点一起填写。

ui:placeholder.en: Required together with the access key
ui:placeholder.zh: 填了 Access Key 就必须填

ui:help.en: Asset Secret Key, stored encrypted separately from the API key. Fill together with Access Key.
ui:help.zh: 素材库 Secret Key，与 API Key 分开加密保存；须与 Access Key 配对。

ui:help.en: Existing full asset URL, used only when the new asset endpoint is empty. An empty value does not select the official service.
ui:help.zh: 保留已有完整素材 URL，仅在新素材库端点留空时使用；空值不会选择官方服务。

ui:help.en: Signing region of the asset library calls; it is part of the signature, so a wrong value is rejected upstream as a signature error rather than a region error. cn-beijing for a relay in front of Ark in China, ap-southeast-1 for the overseas (BytePlus) stack.
ui:help.zh: 素材库调用的签名区域；它是签名的一部分，填错了上游报的是签名错误而不是区域错误。中转的是方舟国内就用 cn-beijing，海外（BytePlus）用 ap-southeast-1。

ui:help.en: Full task collection path or absolute HTTP(S) URL. Submit uses POST here; polling appends /{task_id}. Do not enter only a path prefix. Leave empty to preserve the legacy video-prefix behavior.
ui:help.zh: 填写完整任务集合路径或 http(s) 完整 URL。提交向此地址 POST，查询追加 /{任务ID}；不要只填路径前缀。留空沿用旧视频前缀规则。

ui:help.en: Full path or absolute HTTP(S) URL. Asset calls append Action and Version query parameters and use the separate AK/SK below. If empty, an explicitly configured legacy asset URL is used; otherwise the asset library is disabled. Never defaults to an official endpoint.
ui:help.zh: 填写完整路径或 http(s) 完整 URL。调用自动追加 Action、Version 参数，使用下面独立的 AK/SK。留空仅兼容已显式填写的旧素材地址；两者都未填时不启用素材库，不会默认发送到官方端点。
